scope: Cinco concepts inéditos; nomes, funções e maturidade propostos. Não integrado.

creatures.name: Ressonhiena
creatures.body: Ombros altos, quadril baixo, mandíbula forte, quatro patas de apoio e juba curta de papel agrupado. Garganta de membrana pregueada funciona como caixa de ressonância, sem instrumento pendurado.
creatures.tradeoff: Precisa ancorar o peito para projetar o som; perde mobilidade durante a emissão.
creatures.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original Soulmonsters creature, full body three-quarter view on pure white, generous 8% margins, no lettering, no collage, landscape format. Name for internal intent only: Ressonhiena. Species HYENA, mature quadrupedal beast, not wolf or feline, not humanoid. High bulky shoulders, downward sloping back to smaller hips, rounded hyena ears, broad powerful jaw and angular cheek planes, relatively small alert amber eyes. Mouth open in an unnerving knowing laugh with coherent upper/lower jaw, discrete teeth and visible dark interior. Four rooted paws, a stable asymmetrical bracing gesture and slight torso twist. A living kite creature: 45% living creature,45% kite construction,10% crisp 2D manga/pixel-edge sensibility. The throat and deep chest are inflated pleated kraft-paper resonating volumes, cream/ochre overlapping directional mane clusters of varied sizes, taut plum kite membrane is the flank itself supported by just two integrated curved bamboo ribs, ochre and cyan graphic markings. ONE complete cord tail attached at rump, flowing to two broad torn-paper pennants; all cord belongs to tail, not random floating bows. Anatomy beneath forms has mass, neck overlaps sternum, shoulder meets forelimb, paw compression visible. Not an animal simply wearing equipment. Palette plum purple, burnt ochre, cream, a tiny cyan functional accent. EXPRESSIVE richer middle-scale shapes at cheek, neck, shoulder and wrist, quiet flank plane, no uniform zigzag edge. Art direction clean hand-drawn 2D manga monster concept, confident dark ink contours, bright matte solid color shapes, two or three hard cel-shadow tones, selective tiny stepped contour edges, NO painterly shading, no metallic gloss, no 3D, no photoreal fur, no fullbody polygon crumple, no dense texture, no patches/stitches everywhere, no extra limbs, no wings, no floating tools, no copied franchise anatomy or insignia. Make the species face and living stance the focal point, not ornaments. White background and small simple contact shadow only.

creatures.name: Antamarra
creatures.body: Tronco arredondado pesado, pernas curtas robustas, quatro pés largos, focinho preênsil curto de anta. Grandes superfícies laterais tensionadas formam o próprio torso; dobras macias no pescoço e duas nervuras curvas funcionam como bordas estruturais, não asas.
creatures.tradeoff: O corpo volumoso estabiliza a corrente, mas dificulta curvas rápidas.
creatures.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One original SOULMONSTERS living-kite quadruped, full body on white landscape canvas, no text, generous safe margins. Creature ANTAMARRA inspired by a TAPIR, mature protective marsh rescuer. Not elephant, not pig, not wolf. Round deep barrel chest and rump, four distinct short powerful legs, broad separated toes, small rounded upright ears with cream rims, characteristic short flexible tapir snout curling slightly downward, clear nostrils and small determined dark eyes beneath a sculpted brow, mouth slightly parted with coherent jaw. Bracing diagonally as if resisting a current, near forefoot planted and rear legs set back; neck compresses into shoulders. BODY IS A LIVING KITE made of volumetric taut paper membranes and just a few integrated curved bamboo support ribs: huge petrol blue flank membrane with cream and coral sweeping geometry, broad folded coral dewlap collar compressed beneath the throat, supple large layered paper folds at shoulders, hips and heels. Not an animal wearing a tarp. ONE complete sturdy cord tail from rump finishing in two broad turquoise and coral folded pennants; tail attachment clearly drawn, no floating cords. No wings, no strapped tools, no raft beneath feet. 45% creature,45% kite,10% clean 2D manga pixel-contour sensibility. Materials feel alive: curved taut flank versus compressed collar versus thick quiet cheek planes, varied large and mid-sized shapes. Petroleo dark teal main color, warm coral, ivory, turquoise accents. Clean mature manga creature face, natural tapir shape with original fantastical planes, not cute baby eyes, not angry predator teeth. Confident dark outlines, cel animation model-sheet quality, crisp flat color regions and 2-3 hard-edged shadow values, selective small stepped contour accents only. No realistic skin or fur, no crumpled lowpoly facets everywhere, no paint texture, no metal gloss, no 3D lighting, no stitching/patches, no dense ornament. Strong expressive anatomy and stable four-foot support. Small simple contact shadow only.

creatures.name: Mangufio
creatures.body: Corpo baixo flexível, focinho fino de mangusto, pequenas orelhas redondas, quatro pernas esguias firmes. Faixas de papel sobrepostas nos ombros e dorso abrem como uma gola de desvio, acompanhando a flexão; cauda longa em fita é contrapeso e rabiola.
creatures.attitude: atenção intensa, preparado para uma esquiva
creatures.tradeoff: Precisa ler a trajetória antes de desviar; pouca proteção numa colisão frontal.
creatures.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original Soulmonsters living-kite creature named internally MANGUFIO. Fullbody landscape on white, no lettering, no panel borders, ample margins, no environment. MONGOOSE adult quadruped: long flexible low torso, small rounded ears, narrow pointed mammalian muzzle with short dark nose, almond eyes with sharp intelligent focus, low forehead and visible cheek and jaw volumes, not feline, not wolf, no rabbit ears. Body coils into an S-shaped counterturn: near front paw firmly planting, other front foot reaching across direction of movement, two distinct hind legs springing behind, ALL FOUR LIMBS clearly separate and rooted. Neck flows into long ribcage, waist bends and backleg hocks readable. Tail is one long functional flowing kite cord/membrane tail connected at rump and ending in ONE broad swallowtail pennant, not a fifth leg. Species must remain recognizable as mongoose with sleek active silhouette, expressive bared small teeth but not generic wolf grin. Living kite anatomy: jade and dark wine taut-paper torso, cream flexible layered belly, broad folded shoulder collar swept along the back like overlapping paper vanes creating a directional deflection surface, only a few fine bamboo edge supports integrated into collar, small ochre tension knots at root not giant straps. The paper vanes emerge from shoulder/neck structure, NOT wings or separate tools. Fur-like paper clusters at cheek and wrist are varied and tactile, broad quiet planes on flank, strong near/far overlap and compression. 45% animal presence,45% kite construction,10% crisp2D manga stepped contours. Rich jade green, burgundy plum, ivory, saffron graphic accents. Original clean inked manga monster illustration, flat saturated colors, 2-3 hard cel-shadow tones, no painterly gradients, no realistic fur, no chrome highlights, no lowpoly origami crumpling, no detailed speckle texture, no copied franchise design, no battle armor costume, no weapon, no floating pennants, no extra limbs. Make it alive and elastic, not a neutral animal wearing an accessory. Small simple grounding shadow.

creatures.name: Ouriçorda
creatures.body: Quadrúpede baixo e largo, cabeça roedora pequena mas madura, focinho arredondado e incisivos discretos. Grandes feixes de espinhos achatados de papel rígido e vareta formam um manto orientado para trás com raízes claras. Poucos feixes largos em vez de centenas de agulhas.
creatures.tradeoff: Fechar o manto protege os flancos e limita a rotação do pescoço.
creatures.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE original Soulmonsters creature OURICORDA inspired by PORCUPINE. Entire single mature quadruped in 3/4 landscape isolated white with 8% blank safe border. No text. A low broad alert porcupine, robust round abdomen, four short clearly rooted legs and four dark paws with modest digging claws, small round rodent ears, short blunt sensitive muzzle, black soft nose, small expressive eyes, two modest incisors partially visible at a slightly parted mouth. Do NOT make its face canine, wolf or fox. Face and forequarters peek out of protective mantle, near foreleg carefully stepping sideways while remaining stable, weight pressing paw pads, neck and shoulder compressed. The living-kite body contains a small number of dramatic WIDE FLAT PAPER QUILL bundles radiating backward in a layered protective fan from clear dorsal roots, each bundle broad at base with tapered end, not hundreds of needles. Their cream/copper borders are held taut by thin internal bamboo spars, dark aubergine central membrane with single turquoise geometric stripe. Organic flank is itself supple taut paper, cream folded throat and belly, broad soft cheek folds contrast rigid quill blades. One single complete knotted cord tail emerging behind rump extends toward viewer's side and ends in a broad folded turquoise leaf-pennant. 45% live creature presence,45% functional kite material,10% clean 2D manga selective pixel contour. Palette eggplant purple, warm cream, burnt copper and clear sky blue, value separation and focused saturation. Defensive but intelligent attitude, compact face small relative to body, not baby cartoon. Rhythmic big medium small shapes and restrained details at wrist, cheek and quill roots. Confident black linework, crisp flat cel colors, hard grouped shadows 2-3 values, classic clean anime creature concept. No painterly textures, no realistic fur needles, no gradients or metallic sheen, no robot joints, no extra limbs, no spikes on every surface, no gigantic shield prop, no armor costume, no extra souls, no wings. Keep creature and ALL pennant tips completely within frame. Tiny plain contact shadow only.
creatures.edit_prompt: Edit this original OURICORDA porcupine Soulmonster concept. Preserve the existing full quadruped body, four legs, exact plum/cream/copper/skyblue palette, dorsal flat kite quill fans, their bamboo roots and the complete cord tail, composition and clean 2D manga cel-shaded rendering. CHANGE ONLY THE FACE to read as a mature porcupine creature, less squirrel mascot: reduce eye size substantially and remove giant arched cartoon angry eyebrows; set small narrow deep attentive eyes under subtle orbital planes. Lengthen the blunt rodent muzzle a little, give the maxilla and lower jaw defined volume, smaller restrained incisors rather than large buckteeth, nostrils on a broad blunt nose. Replace inflated round cheek pads with a few layered directional cream paper cheek tufts flowing toward the neck; remove long whisker lines. Small ears stay rounded and attached to skull. Attitude vigilant and serious, not snarling wolf, not human face. Keep the head small relative to protective body. Preserve crisp flat colors and grouped hard shadows with no glossy highlights or realistic fur. Background pure white, no text. Preserve every appendage and pennant tip inside frame, allow more breathing room if needed.

creatures.name: Bufarol
creatures.verb: abrir passagem e proteger quem vem atrás
creatures.body: Peito profundo e muito largo, cabeça bovina baixa com focinho largo e dois chifres curvos únicos, quatro pernas fortes com cascos fendidos. Peitoral de membrana convexa é parte do tórax vivo, nervuras curvas nas laterais e pescoço com dobras espessas. Chifres e peito canalizam esforço, sem arma colada.
creatures.palette: azul noite, terracota, creme dourado, lima pontual
creatures.tradeoff: Muito forte em avanço frontal, precisa de espaço para mudar direção.
creatures.prompt: Use case stylized-concept. One original fullbody SOULMONSTERS BUFAROL, mature WATER BUFFALO living kite guardian, not bull minotaur, not rhinoceros, not a robot, not humanoid. Three-quarter front landscape white background and safe margins around ALL horns, tail and feet, no text. Very deep wide shoulder/chest, heavy body, four strong rooted legs with cloven hooves, lower wide pelvis and neck shortened by powerful shoulder mass, head low and slightly turned, broad long buffalo muzzle with coherent nostrils, small steady eyes under projecting brow, heavy lower jaw with a slightly open visible mouth corner. Exactly TWO large swept crescent horns grow from skull, wide lateral roots then curve upward, made of layered pale bamboo sheath and dark terracotta tips; no third horn, no headgem, no nose ring. Protective determined calm attitude, weight loaded into near foreleg, far foreleg a little behind, separated hindlegs planted; sturdy massive quadruped not longleg deer. Its torso IS a large convex dark midnight blue kite membrane with big warm terracotta and creamy gold fields; ribs integrate as two structural arcs from chest to flank; overlapping thick cream paper folds at jaw, neck and shoulders express mass, chest expands like a wind-filled protective bow. Not a creature wearing a saddle, no giant attached weapon. Small lime woven knot details at functional rib endings only. Single complete tail attached at rump with a short cord section and one broad dark blue/terracotta folded kite pennant. Material hierarchy: soft layered neck, taut torso, hard horn sheaths, compressed hoof contact. 45% expressive creature,45% integrated kite construction,10% crisp clean 2D manga/selectively stepped ink edges. Face adult bovine, not baby mascot. Large medium small shape hierarchy with rich construction at cheek/shoulder/carpus and broad quiet flanks. Saturated midnight navy, terracotta, creamy gold and tiny lime accents. Classic clean 2D anime monster concept, bold confident dark outlines, flat matte color shapes, restrained 2-3 hard cel shadow tones. No glossy realistic metal, no 3D render, no atmospheric effects, no noise texture, no origami triangles all over, no patches, no horns/spikes everywhere, no armor humanoid costume, no extra limbs. A little plain contact shadow only.
